_comment: B-TRUTH Second Canonical Test Company (2026-09-06, PR 6 of the ONE_PRODUCT_CANONICAL_MIGRATION plan). These are deterministic FAKE INPUT rows only — the raw, company-provided-style records that a real client would upload. They are consumed by scripts/koratest-canonical-seed.ts (via --fixture=data/koratest/boscoverde_input_fixture.json) and pushed through the real canonical ingestion -> UEF -> eligibility -> scoring -> Decision Pack pipeline. No field here is a KORA-computed output; every downstream result is produced by invoking the same canonical functions a real tenant uses. This is a clearly fictional test company, not modeled on any real identifiable organization, and is NOT presented as empirical market evidence. Deliberately distinct from KoraTest Srl's own fixture: different workforce size, different row count, a cooperative/social-enterprise category mix skewed toward inclusione sociale/volontariato/collaborazione rather than KoraTest's training/mentoring-heavy mix, its own separate limited/blocked/incomplete rows — so future cross-company product surfaces have meaningful, non-degenerate variation to work with, not two copies of the same numbers.
